required_clarifications: Describe compute-only comparison as the earlier TSH1 short-job campaign, not a measurement of current TSH2.
Call the four recordings held out during software selection, then a physical replication set. Hardware repetitions do not create new unseen examples.
Quality and natural byte comparisons use original five-second support; physical transactions include separately reported zero padding to eight seconds.
Strict packet validation runs inside decode timing; numerical equality qualification runs after each timed batch.

natural_quality_gates.baseline_active_definition: group band energy >= max(1e9, 1e-4 * group total energy)
natural_quality_gates.natural_events: Compare with threshold-zero clusters by baseline primary-band membership and nearest unused onset within 0.256 s. Report missed/added clusters and delay. This is not labeled recognition accuracy.
natural_quality_gates.quality_groups: Use interior frames f=1 through NS/128-1, consecutive 48-frame groups, discard incomplete final group. Natural clips yield 39 groups.

denominators.physical_prefix_check: Exact original_NS/128+1 complete packet prefix, unchanged physical bytes, checked against original finite-reference packet/feature/power/monitor outputs.
denominators.quality_scope: Original support only with original_NS passed to grouping. Added silence is excluded from application conclusions.
denominators.byte_scope: Sparse and compact dense encode identical thresholded powers and same frames. Exclude separate reconstructed waveform and network framing. Full physical bytes and original-support prefix bytes are separate.
denominators.summary_scope: 6552-byte CPU task summary is not emitted by current FPGA and summary encoding is outside benchmark timing.

timing.downstream_flute: Historical physical spectral packets, cached RAM, i7-8750H, 30 paired trials. Consumer stage uses predecoded data. Decode+consumer stage includes strict TSP1 validation/checksum and integer 16-band features. Numerical expected-feature comparison follows timing.
timing.monitor_v02: Software-reference spectra, four original five-second held-out recordings, 30 paired trials. Receiver routes include strict native packet decode/validation, materialized feature arrays and common Python monitor aggregation/event logic. Numerical feature/monitor equality check follows each timed batch.
timing.monitor_cpu_model: Not retained in this campaign registration/validation; do not borrow adjacent i7-8750H metadata.
timing.excluded: Upstream FPGA/DSP producer for cached spectral routes, transport, disk, context creation, numerical expected-output qualification; no total system, power, AI or utilization claim.
timing.monitor_receiver_aggregate: Median of the four per-recording medians of paired dense/sparse elapsed ratios: 1.3107304907. Not a ratio of aggregate medians and not an average of per-recording medians.

earlier_compute_only.profile: Historical TSH1, not current finite-file TSH2
earlier_compute_only.cpu: Intel Core i7-8750H, native Windows, scalar MSVC /O2, one pinned thread
earlier_compute_only.jobs: Six finite jobs: two 1024-sample flute excerpts, each at thresholds 0, 1e8 and 1e11.
earlier_compute_only.includes: Resident input, per-job initialization, FFT, thresholding, IFFT/WOLA, full tail, sparse packet generation.
earlier_compute_only.excludes: External input loading, allocation, immutable input-range validation, output readback, file I/O, Ethernet and external hashing.
earlier_compute_only.trials: Three warmups plus 30 measured jobs per implementation per case. Separate CPU and FPGA campaigns; ratio of medians, not paired trials.
earlier_compute_only.recommended_readme_sentence: In an earlier matched resident-compute comparison of six 1,024-sample jobs, the TSH1 FPGA implementation took 4.23-6.25 times the i7-8750H laptop median time. This is separate from the current TSH2 eight-second capture and sparse-consumer results.

publication: Derived compact review only; artifact identifiers refer to immutable local archives. No private boot identifiers or personal filesystem paths are exported. Original 13-file allowlist remains unchanged.
